Help

Navigation

Tap ☰ to choose a book. Use the Chapter / Verse buttons to jump to any chapter or verse. In ⇥ you can type a reference like John 3:16 or యోహాను 3:16.

Verse links

Tap any verse and press 🔗 Link to copy a link to that verse. In your commentary, write a reference like John 3:16 and it becomes a clickable link automatically.

Commentary

Tap a verse number to open the commentary editor. Tap the verse text for commentary and actions. On every verse, tap the orange ✎ button to edit the verse text itself (typo / alternate reading). Notes and edits stay on this device (offline).

Edit verse text

Use the ✎ on each verse, or ✎ Edit verse in the commentary box / panel / popover. Save applies the change everywhere; ↺ Restore original undoes it. Edited verses show an orange ✎ badge.

Word highlights

Select a word and tap a colour to highlight it. Just like comments, a highlight then applies to every occurrence of that word in the Bible. The ⌀ button removes it everywhere.

Word comments

Select a word (or a phrase) in a verse, tap 💬 and type your comment. It then appears on every occurrence of that word in the whole Bible, not only the verse you wrote it in. Tap an underlined word to read the comment; press Delete to remove it everywhere.

Export as a document

In Notes, tap 📄 Word to save your notes and comments as a Word document, or 🖨 PDF to open a print view, then choose Save as PDF.

Backup reminder

If you have notes and have not backed up for a while, a reminder appears at the top of the Notes tab. Tap Backup now to save a restorable copy.

Backup / Restore

Backup saves all your Bible changes — commentary, notes, favorites, labels, highlights, word comments, verse edits and settings — into one JSON file. Sermons are backed up separately from the Sermon Library. Restore loads the Bible backup back. Backups are manual — the app keeps no automatic copy.

Sync between devices (phone ⇄ PC)

The app keeps everything on the device itself and never sends your data anywhere. To move it, use files: on one device tap Backup (or Save a backup file) and save the JSON into a cloud folder you already use — Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox. On the other device, open the app and Restore that file. Do this each time you switch, keeping the newest file as your master. Once you have used a backup file, ↻ Re-open last backup reads that same file again in one tap — handy when it lives in a synced folder and changes on the other device.

Sermons on other devices

Each sermon can travel on its own. In the sermon editor tap ⤓ Export to save it as a file named after its Series - Title; keep those files in a cloud folder to carry a single sermon between phone and PC. In the Sermons tab, Back up writes one Series - Title file per sermon (plus a combined file) into your chosen folder, and Import reads either a single sermon file or a whole library.

Sermon series

In a sermon, choose the Book and type the chapter in Reference — the app then offers a code for each series (e.g. CO-1000, CS-1000, SER-1000 for John 3) as buttons under the Series box. Add or remove series in Settings → Sermon series.

Commentary import file format

{
 "John 3:16": "The key verse about God's love.",
 "Genesis 1:1": "The beginning of creation."
}

Both English and Telugu book names work.
